review_reason: This execution environment provides no filesystem write access for binary content (no shell, and the browser automation layer can persist only text returned from the page). All 20 documents were fetched over HTTPS and hashed byte-for-byte in memory, but no local copy exists, so access_status is ACCESSIBLE_NOT_DOWNLOADED rather than DOWNLOADED, and local_file is NULL.
resolution_needed: Re-run the same fetch-and-hash step in an environment with filesystem access; the recorded SHA-256 values allow byte-exact verification of any later download

review_reason: BIS publishes no issue date, revision number or effective date alongside these FMCS forms. HTTP Last-Modified reflects a 29 June 2026 server-side migration for most files and is therefore NOT a document date; it is recorded in source_inventory.csv only. date, version and effective_date are NULL rather than inferred.
resolution_needed: BIS would need to publish document dates/versions

review_reason: No PDF text extraction was performed, so no fact in provenance.csv is attributed to a specific PDF page, section heading or clause number derived from a PDF. All page values are NULL. Every evidence_text is quoted from an official BIS HTML page or from the official BIS database, where page numbers do not apply. clause is NULL for the same reason, except that the Nomination of AIR page is noted as containing lettered clauses a) to e).
resolution_needed: Add a PDF text-extraction step to populate page, section and clause for PDF-derived facts

review_reason: No Indian Standard PDFs, Product Manuals, Schemes of Inspection and Testing, QCOs, QCO amendments, Gazette orders or BIS circulars were collected in this pass.
